strings.Bridges and buildings: load paths, const: Buundooyinka iyo dhismayaasha: waddooyinka culeyska, dhismaha iyo xaqiijinta.
strings.Each course has 5 stages and 40 steps: l: Koorso kastaa waxay leedahay 5 marxaladood iyo 40 tallaabo: culeysyada iyo nidaamka qaab-dhismeedka, agabka iyo isku-xidhka, dhismaha iyo xakamaynta marxaladaha, tijaabinta iyo la-socodka, adkeysiga iyo wareejinta; cutub kasta waxa loo qaybiyaa waddada culeyska, xisaabinta, xaqiijinta iyo baaritaanka cilladaha. Laga bilaabo Buundada Akashi Kaikyō iyo Millau Viaduct ilaa Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa iyo Sydney Opera House, oo leh tirooyin muhiim ah, jadwallo waqti, xeerarka naqshadaynta iyo isbarbardhigga mashaariicda caanka ah. Qaybta kowaad ee koorso kastaa waa bilaash.
strings.Explore {n} bridge and building subdisci: Sahami {n} laan-hoosaad oo buundooyinka iyo dhismayaasha ah
strings.100 guided courses on suspension, cable-: 100 koorso oo la hagayo oo ku saabsan buundooyinka la sudhay, buundooyinka xadhkaha lagu taageero iyo buundooyinka qaansada ah, ka-gudubyada badda, munaaradaha aadka u dhaadheer, saqafyada ballaaran ee aan tiirar lahayn, yaraynta gariirka, naqshadaynta dhulgariirka, wejiyada dhismayaasha iyo dhismaha dhijitaalka ah.
strings.Load paths, construction stages and meas: Waddooyinka culeyska, marxaladaha dhismaha iyo xaqiijinta la cabbiray ayaa isku xidha koorsooyinka; buundooyinka iyo dhismayaashu waxay adeegsadaan isku-darka culeysyada, xeerar iyo shuruudo aqbalaad oo kala duwan.

strings.Bridge durability, inspection and health: Adkeysiga buundooyinka, kormeerka iyo la-socodka caafimaadka qaab-dhismeedka
strings.Supertall building landmarks: Dhismayaasha caanka ah ee aadka u dhaadheer
strings.Tall-building structural systems and dam: Nidaamyada qaab-dhismeedka dhismayaasha dhaadheer iyo yaraynta gariirka
strings.Landmark buildings and long-span roofs: Dhismayaasha caanka ah iyo saqafyada ballaaran ee aan tiirar lahayn

strings.From bridge components to record spans: Laga bilaabo qaybaha buundada ilaa dhererka rikoodhka ah
strings.Start with bearings, joints, main cables: Ka bilow fadhiyada culeyska, kala-goysyada, xadhkaha waaweyn iyo xadhkaha taageerada, kadibna isbarbardhig mashaariicda buundooyinka la sudhay, kuwa xadhkaha lagu taageero iyo ka-gudubyada badda.
strings.From tall-building systems to supertall: Laga bilaabo nidaamyada dhismayaasha dhaadheer ilaa dhismayaasha caanka ah ee aadka u dhaadheer
strings.Learn outriggers, diagrids, dampers and: Baro outrigger-ka, diagrid-ka, qalabka yareeya gariirka iyo gaabashada kala duwan ee tiirarka, kadibna isbarbardhig Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa iyo Shanghai Tower.
strings.Landmark projects to compare: Mashaariic caan ah oo la isbarbardhigo

strings.Prices are set in TWD, converted at the: Qiimayaasha waxa lagu dejiyaa TWD, waxa lagu beddelaa sicirka sarrifka ugu dambeeyay, waxana kor loogu soo koobaa qiime maxalli ah oo nadiif ah.
strings.Exchange rates are an approximate seed u: Sicirka sarrifku waa qiyaas bilow ah ilaa laga soo helo sicirrada ugu dambeeyay; qiimaha server-ka ee lacag-bixinta ayaa ah kan go'an.
